programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 883
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 阿贤上酒楼 / Axian Restaurant Trails Episode 3
programme.desc: 酒楼是不少华人的集体回忆，不管是公司尾牙、开工酒、散伙饭、祝寿等，都会选择上酒楼，而酒楼菜色也是许多传统味道的传承。在这个节目中，阿贤将带大家一起上酒楼吃菜咯！ Chinese Restaurants, acclaimed as the pinnacle of Chinese cuisine, are considered culinary treasures. “Axian Restaurant Trails” will take viewers on a journey to explore the essence of restaurant culture and savour the enticing dishes that once swept through these establishments.

Moon Jung In, an ambitious woman, married Dr. Baek Dong Ho for his wealth, stole his assets, and left him. She became successful and now runs her own entertainment company. programme.title: 玫瑰的故事 / The Tale of Rose Episode 25
programme.desc: 出生于书香世家的黄亦玫一路在呵护中长大，从小便展露出艺术天赋。初入职场的黄亦玫很快受到重用，与合作伙伴庄国栋相识相爱，但最终错过彼此，这段职场磨炼也令她对自己的人生有了更清晰的规划，决定重返校园求学深造。毕业后，她和学长方协文步入婚姻殿堂。可婚后两人发展方向相去甚远，最 终选择离婚。黄亦玫开始创业，在艺术品策展领域打拼出一片天地，在此期间还遇到了自己的灵魂伴侣溥家明，可溥家明只剩几个月的生命，两人这段爱情最终以生死离别画上句号。 但黄亦玫没有就此消沉，她还是一如既往地为活出更精彩的自己而努力着。

programme.title: 玉簟秋 / The Lament of Autumn
programme.desc: A failed assassination throws Ye Pingjun into danger. Accused of aiding the killers, she challenges powerful warlord heir Yu Changxuan to find the truth within ten days.

programme.title: 玉簟秋 / The Lament of Autumn Episode 2
programme.desc: Yu Changxuan saves Pingjun from a vicious attack, but she secretly helps a wanted assassin escape. Her lies soon put her back in his sights.

programme.title: 玉簟秋 / The Lament of Autumn Episode 3
programme.desc: A tragic confession clears Pingjun’s name. Furious at the injustice, she confronts Changxuan, only for him to become increasingly fascinated by her defiance.

programme.title: 玉簟秋 / The Lament of Autumn Episode 4
programme.desc: Pingjun discovers Changxuan is using her to make another woman jealous. Their fake romance becomes a dangerous game of manipulation and unexpected attraction.

programme.title: 真料理两锅论第二季 / Let's Guo S2 Episode 10
programme.desc: 料理实境节目《真料理两锅论》由邰智源、罗时丰、黄镫辉、KID林柏升、温妮、丘涵共同主持。节目中主持人们将分为两组PK对决，亲自出马找寻稀有食材、超强主厨及传奇秘方与菜单，献上最美味的完美料理。Cooking reality show “Let’s Guo” is hosted by Taiwanese artistes Tai Chih-yuan, Lo Shih-feng, Huang Chien-hui, KID Lin Po-sheng, Winnie, and Chiu Han. In the show, the hosts are divided into two teams for competition, venturing out to seek for rare ingredients, exceptional chefs, and legendary recipes and menus, presenting the most delicious and perfect dishes.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius Episode 13
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 884
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 很想很想你 / Love Me, Love My Voice Episode 31
programme.desc: 该剧根据墨宝非宝的同名小说《很想很想你》改编。主要讲述热爱音乐的大四学生顾声坚持梦想，默默坚守着另一个隐藏身份——古风圈小透明“声声慢”，并憧憬着能与自己的心动对象配音圈大神“锖青磁”合作一次的故事。

programme.desc: 《天赐的声音》第7季强势回归，节目邀请了十二至十五位歌手担任音乐合伙人，并由他们自行进行两两配对演唱；如果合伙人数量为单数，则最终会有一名歌手在该集节目轮空。在每轮歌曲演唱后，声音鉴赏团成员会在已演唱的歌曲中共同选出待定金曲，最终获得推荐金曲的搭档将分别担任下一期的队长，带领本队的三对歌手进行歌曲表演并角逐金曲称号。从第二阶段起，每期均会由在场观看录制的两百位观众额外选出一首人气金曲。“The Treasured Voice” is a captivating singing variety that sees each episode having different groups of music partners to sing together in pairs. programme.title: 恋爱兄妹 / My Sibling’s Romance Episode 14
programme.desc: 《恋爱兄妹》节目以“恋爱兄妹，让爱加倍”为主轴，邀请4对原生兄妹或姐弟入住恋爱小屋，各自寻找心仪的另一半。蒋敦豪、宋妍霏、吴尊、小鹿、杨亘、朱丹及木春组成的“恋爱家友团”将作为观察员，与观众一同推理手足关系和他们各自的恋爱选择，见证充满温情与欢笑的恋爱生活。“My Sibling’s Romance” is a dating reality show that introduces a unique, family-oriented twist to the traditional dating format. programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 36
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 你也有今天 / My Boss Episode 17
programme.desc: 怀揣着律师梦想的纯真少女成瑶，被一个最顶级的律师事务所录取，于是她决定搬到离公司近一些的地方住可以更好的工作。没想到房东一房两租，成瑶跟另一个租客发生争吵。结果那个人竟然是成瑶律所的老板钱恒。钱恒第一天就把成瑶调进自己的小组，开始了魔鬼训练，然而训练的目的却是为了要赶走靠关系进来的成瑶。成瑶不明真相以为是自己幸运，加倍努力，在一系列的魔鬼训练中表现突出，反而让钱恒刮目相看。两个人在工作和生活的朝夕相处中，从互相不对付，到彼此关心，逐渐擦出了爱情的火花。经历了风风雨雨，成瑶成长为一个合格的律师，也跟钱恒走向了幸福的婚姻。

programme.desc: 该剧根据墨宝非宝的同名小说《很想很想你》改编。主要讲述热爱音乐的大四学生顾声坚持梦想，默默坚守着另一个隐藏身份——古风圈小透明“声声慢”，并憧憬着能与自己的心动对象配音圈大神“锖青磁”合作一次的故事。

programme.title: 你也有今天 / My Boss Episode 17
programme.desc: 怀揣着律师梦想的纯真少女成瑶，被一个最顶级的律师事务所录取，于是她决定搬到离公司近一些的地方住可以更好的工作。没想到房东一房两租，成瑶跟另一个租客发生争吵。结果那个人竟然是成瑶律所的老板钱恒。钱恒第一天就把成瑶调进自己的小组，开始了魔鬼训练，然而训练的目的却是为了要赶走靠关系进来的成瑶。成瑶不明真相以为是自己幸运，加倍努力，在一系列的魔鬼训练中表现突出，反而让钱恒刮目相看。两个人在工作和生活的朝夕相处中，从互相不对付，到彼此关心，逐渐擦出了爱情的火花。经历了风风雨雨，成瑶成长为一个合格的律师，也跟钱恒走向了幸福的婚姻。

programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 36
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 奔跑吧 12 / Keep Running 12 Episode 6
programme.desc: <奔跑吧第12季>强势回归，超人气大咖艺人继续担纲主持，依据每一期节目主题到设定的各个任务地点进行游戏和追逐战，争取在竞赛中取得更多提示，以有利于进行最后的游戏环节，完成最终“撕名牌”环节。每一期胜出的队伍或成员将获得该期胜利奖品，每一季的完结将有一组总冠军队伍诞生。

programme.desc: 该剧根据墨宝非宝的同名小说《很想很想你》改编。主要讲述热爱音乐的大四学生顾声坚持梦想，默默坚守着另一个隐藏身份——古风圈小透明“声声慢”，并憧憬着能与自己的心动对象配音圈大神“锖青磁”合作一次的故事。

programme.title: 你也有今天 / My Boss Episode 18
programme.desc: 怀揣着律师梦想的纯真少女成瑶，被一个最顶级的律师事务所录取，于是她决定搬到离公司近一些的地方住可以更好的工作。没想到房东一房两租，成瑶跟另一个租客发生争吵。结果那个人竟然是成瑶律所的老板钱恒。钱恒第一天就把成瑶调进自己的小组，开始了魔鬼训练，然而训练的目的却是为了要赶走靠关系进来的成瑶。成瑶不明真相以为是自己幸运，加倍努力，在一系列的魔鬼训练中表现突出，反而让钱恒刮目相看。两个人在工作和生活的朝夕相处中，从互相不对付，到彼此关心，逐渐擦出了爱情的火花。经历了风风雨雨，成瑶成长为一个合格的律师，也跟钱恒走向了幸福的婚姻。

programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 37
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. But Fu Yixiao accidentally falls off a cliff shortly after the battle and loses her memory. Feng Suige uses Fu Yixiao to find out the truth as to why he is being heavil...

programme.title: 天赐的声音 6 / The Treasured Voice 6 Episode 5
programme.desc: 《天赐的声音》突破了歌手独唱、歌手与素人合作等固有模式，定位更专业化的音乐表演，邀请乐坛中成熟的歌手共同合作演绎金曲，意在实现寻求品质音乐和专业审美的回归。

programme.title: 丑闻 / Snow White's Revenge Episode 19
programme.desc: 正茵离奇死亡，手中紧握着一张预告她死期的纸条。多年前，她曾参与谋杀白雪娥的父亲并夺走其财产，如今尘封的罪恶终于反噬。当白雪娥发现前男友徐真浩竟与仇人正茵关系密切，她决定以一部电视剧为棋局展开复仇。然而，当剧中的复仇逐渐照进现实，正茵之死也留下最危险的疑问，即白雪娥究竟是复仇者，还是凶手? programme.title: 在暴雪时分 / Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 凤凰台上 / Love and Crown Episode 10
programme.desc: 女侠凌苍苍凭借着侠肝义胆和出奇制胜的武功，在江湖中创立了匡扶正义的门派凤来阁。南祁王朝年轻的皇帝萧焕一心为民，然而首辅大臣联合江湖势力把持朝政，祸乱百姓。萧焕为拯救苍生于苦难，化名“白迟帆”微服私访行走江湖，并认识了行侠仗义的凤来阁阁主凌苍苍。二人一起仗剑天涯，除暴安良，惺惺相惜，却不料凌苍苍就是首辅的女儿，并即将成为他的皇后。面对江湖动乱、百姓受难，心怀大义的萧焕和凌苍苍携手平乱赈灾、惩处贪墨。他们在为百姓谋福祉的过程中，也寻获自身的价值。Ling Cang Cang, the founder of Fenglai Pavilion, fights for justice in a world troubled by corrupted officials. programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 在暴雪时分 / Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 你也有今天 / My Boss Episode 19
programme.desc: 怀揣着律师梦想的纯真少女成瑶，被一个最顶级的律师事务所录取，于是她决定搬到离公司近一些的地方住可以更好的工作。没想到房东一房两租，成瑶跟另一个租客发生争吵。结果那个人竟然是成瑶律所的老板钱恒。钱恒第一天就把成瑶调进自己的小组，开始了魔鬼训练，然而训练的目的却是为了要赶走靠关系进来的成瑶。成瑶不明真相以为是自己幸运，加倍努力，在一系列的魔鬼训练中表现突出，反而让钱恒刮目相看。两个人在工作和生活的朝夕相处中，从互相不对付，到彼此关心，逐渐擦出了爱情的火花。经历了风风雨雨，成瑶成长为一个合格的律师，也跟钱恒走向了幸福的婚姻。

programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 38
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. But Fu Yixiao accidentally falls off a cliff shortly after the battle and loses her memory. Feng Suige uses Fu Yixiao to find out the truth as to why he is being heavil...

programme.title: 梦想改造家 S11 / Dream Home S11 Episode 4
programme.desc: 新一季“梦改”一方面将延承节目在家装领域的优势资源，匹配合适的设计师对委托空间进行功能性改造，打破空间限制。无论是在一平米的空间上施展“收纳魔法”，还是解决房屋发霉漏水、隔音差等棘手问题，设计师都将以理性攻破实际的居住困境。另一方面，节目更关注委托背后的情感诉求，以感性提供情绪价值，破解精神困局。

programme.desc: 女侠凌苍苍凭借着侠肝义胆和出奇制胜的武功，在江湖中创立了匡扶正义的门派凤来阁。南祁王朝年轻的皇帝萧焕一心为民，然而首辅大臣联合江湖势力把持朝政，祸乱百姓。萧焕为拯救苍生于苦难，化名“白迟帆”微服私访行走江湖，并认识了行侠仗义的凤来阁阁主凌苍苍。二人一起仗剑天涯，除暴安良，惺惺相惜，却不料凌苍苍就是首辅的女儿，并即将成为他的皇后。面对江湖动乱、百姓受难，心怀大义的萧焕和凌苍苍携手平乱赈灾、惩处贪墨。他们在为百姓谋福祉的过程中，也寻获自身的价值。Ling Cang Cang, the founder of Fenglai Pavilion, fights for justice in a world troubled by corrupted officials. programme.title: Dialogue
programme.desc: Dialogue is a prime time daily English talk show on CGTN. programme.desc: During World War II, fireballs called “Foo Fighters” terrorize American airmen in Europe's night skies, as pilots swear they defy the laws of physics.

programme.title: Mountain Men (S14) Episode 3
programme.desc: Chance and Soraya slaughter a ram for meat for their growing family, while Lauro starts this year's Iditarod preparation with a fall training run for his team.

programme.title: The Curse Of Oak Island (S12) Episode 14
programme.desc: After months of tireless work and focused research, a massive excavation begins to recover the fabled Chappell Vault.

programme.title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames (S1) Episode 5
programme.desc: From ancient war machines to devastating weapons of mass destruction, explore the deadly military innovations that changed warfare and rank among history's deadliest.

programme.title: Special Forces (S1) Episode 2
programme.desc: The hardiest men endure 5 weeks of physical and psychological hell, training for a 1500ft jump. Only the brave will join the 800 Marines who earn the right to be called Force Recon.

programme.title: The Presidents Episode 3
programme.desc: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

programme.title: The Presidents Episode 4
programme.desc: Explore Bill Clinton's complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 2
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 2
programme.desc: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essie's, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 3
programme.desc: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter s'mores in scenic Canandaigua!

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 4
programme.desc: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 5
programme.desc: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 6
programme.desc: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3
programme.desc: Ben's food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 2
programme.desc: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 3
programme.desc: It's asparagus season – Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the ‘Soil Sisters' a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 4
programme.desc: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 5
programme.desc: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 6
programme.desc: Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3
programme.desc: Ben's food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 2
programme.desc: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 Episode 3
programme.desc: It's asparagus season – Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the ‘Soil Sisters' a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bays are magnets for rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current Episode 2
programme.desc: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it's the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the foundation for an intricate marine food chain

programme.title: The Humboldt Current Episode 3
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a study in survival.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 10
programme.desc: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China
programme.desc: Adam Liaw arrives in his mum's home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 2
programme.desc: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 3
programme.desc: Adam's journey to explore China's history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 4
programme.desc: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

programme.title: Edge Of Existence
programme.desc: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

programme.title: Edge Of Existence Episode 2
programme.desc: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

programme.title: Edge Of Existence Episode 3
programme.desc: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 7
programme.desc: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 8
programme.desc: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

programme.title: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
programme.desc: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

programme.title: Minecraft: The Next Revolution
programme.desc: In May 2009, Markus "Notch" Persson launched a humble indie game named Minecraft. With intuitive play and infinite creativity, it became the best-selling video game of all time—evolving from a simple side project into a massive global phenomenon!

programme.title: The Story Of Playstation
programme.desc: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world's most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

programme.title: The Story Of Nintendo
programme.desc: From humble beginnings manufacturing 'Hanufuda' cards came one of the world's most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

programme.title: The Presidents Episode 5
programme.desc: Documentary examines George W. Bush's presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

programme.title: The Presidents Episode 6

programme.desc: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it's the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. programme.title: The Humboldt Current Episode 3
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a study in survival.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Owls
programme.desc: This stunning series uncovers 'The Secret Life Of Owls' as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Owls Episode 2
programme.desc: This stunning series uncovers 'The Secret Life Of Owls' as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2
programme.desc: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 3
programme.desc: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you've seen. And it's here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 5
programme.desc: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won't be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as ‘Cape Malay'.

programme.title: Edge Of Existence Episode 3
programme.desc: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

programme.title: The Dinosaur Echo
programme.desc: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

programme.title: Mega Transports Specials
programme.desc: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ & Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 2
programme.desc: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essie's, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 3
programme.desc: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter s'mores in scenic Canandaigua!

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 4
programme.desc: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 5
programme.desc: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

programme.title: New York Gourmet Episode 6
programme.desc: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: Eat With David S3
programme.desc: David explores Suzhou's historic Shantang Street, tasting iconic local specialties like pan-fried buns at Xin Zhen Yuan and traditional noodles at Lu Zhen Xing, a century-old eatery. Between culinary stops, he wanders through classical gardens like Zhuo Zheng Yuan capturing the timeless elegance of Suzhou life.

programme.title: Eat With David S3 Episode 2
programme.desc: A modern twist on Suzhou dining unfolds at Jinji Lake, where David reunites with longtime friend Rich Chin. Together, they visit Larry's Other Kitchen (LOK) — a local favorite serving authentic Vietnamese cuisine — and explore how global flavors are reshaping Suzhou's evolving food scene.

programme.title: Eat With David S3 Episode 3
programme.desc: In Vancouver, David begins at Stanley Park, enjoying coffee by the waterfront before heading to Gastown, where history and modernity meet. The day culminates at the Top of Vancouver revolving restaurant with media personality Chelsea Jiang, as they dine on Pacific salmon and Alberta beef while overlooking the city skyline.

programme.title: Eat With David S3 Episode 4
programme.desc: From Granville Island to Chinatown, David explores Vancouver's cultural mosaic through food and fashion. With guest Riko Wang, founder of Couturist, he visits New Town Bakery for classic Hong Kong–style noodles — a reflection of Vancouver's diverse creative spirit.

programme.title: Eat With David S3 Episode 5
programme.desc: David discovers how Vancouver balances natural beauty with city life. From Queen Elizabeth Park to English Bay and Steveston Village, he joins media host Jessica Chou for seaside dining and conversations celebrating the city's East–West culinary harmony.

programme.title: Eat With David S3 Episode 6
programme.desc: Exploring Vancouver's North Shore, David joins filmmaker Isabel Leung for a Szechuan feast led by Chef Sun, a Chengdu-trained master. Between mountain landscapes and fiery flavors, they uncover how culture and cuisine unite across continents.

programme.title: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
programme.desc: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 8
programme.desc: Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Step into the ring with nature's top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches who've developed a taste for blood.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world's 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature's best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. They've also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants' needs - and to see if they're returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Learn about the world's largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundy's surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the world's fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the world's longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant's Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada's only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark's most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia's shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.desc: Welcome to India – a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

programme.desc: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It's a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

We'll take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.

programme.title: Wild Rockies Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs can't grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

programme.title: Wild Rockies Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: For a great many species, the structures of group living are the most important for survival. Although social living is integral to many of the animals that call the Rocky Mountains home, no two species organize their society in the same way. Even among closely related species there can be drastic differences in social structure; communication, hierarchy, mating, and diet are all inextricably informed by specific environmental and genetic adaptations for group survival.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Zambia's Luangwa Valley is home to Africa's biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 7
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to sur...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 8
programme.desc: Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Boss Shark: Chasing Giants
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Dive to the darkest depths of the sea to uncover the ocean's most mysterious inhabitants. Journey across vast stretches of open water with humpback whales, then wander down to the ocean floor to witness breathtaking bioluminescence.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Venture along Earth's coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia's far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth's most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Massive elephant seals go nose to nose to win the title of “beachmaster,” and giant petrels earn the nickname, “murderous garbagemen.” Meanwhile, a female humpback goes to extremes to protect her calf from amorous males.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcon's speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owl's stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamander's death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australia's best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Coastal Africa Season 1
programme.desc: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: It's not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who'll risk his life for love.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And what's it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Coastal Africa Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: On Africa's east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recently found population of "living fossils", the Coelacanth, which dwell in deep, submarine canyons.

programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It's time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.title: 但愿人长久 / Teresa Teng Episode 26
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了“华语世界永恒的声音”邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的“超级女声”的奋斗之路 。Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asia’s most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.title: 婚内婚外 / Married Episode 16
programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在“无微不至”的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相。在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的“美满”婚姻中挣脱出来。而在找回自我、尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助。然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的“战斗”就此打响。

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 55
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 55
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 婚内婚外 / Married Episode 16
programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在“无微不至”的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相。在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的“美满”婚姻中挣脱出来。而在找回自我、尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助。然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的“战斗”就此打响。

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 983
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 738
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 255
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 257
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 126
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2 / Listen! Taiwan Sings 2 Episode 9
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事。他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力。新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事。Hosted by Wonfu’s frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwan's people and heritage.

programme.title: 风味转身 / Flavor Tailor Episode 6
programme.desc: 节目走访台湾十三种经历复育、传承或亟待被看见的农渔物产，深入产地跟随农渔民走进真实日常，从凌晨采收到彻夜制作，在台风、暴雨与严苛环境中，以最贴近土地的视角，记录他们守护风土、延续技艺的坚持与韧性。Across Taiwan, this series explores 13 revived, preserved, or overlooked agricultural and fishery treasures, following farmers and fishers through long days, wild weather, and hard-earned traditions rooted in the land.

programme.title: 但愿人长久 / Teresa Teng Episode 27
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了“华语世界永恒的声音”邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的“超级女声”的奋斗之路 。Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asia’s most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 245
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。

programme.title: 风味转身 / Flavor Tailor Episode 6
programme.desc: 节目走访台湾十三种经历复育、传承或亟待被看见的农渔物产，深入产地跟随农渔民走进真实日常，从凌晨采收到彻夜制作，在台风、暴雨与严苛环境中，以最贴近土地的视角，记录他们守护风土、延续技艺的坚持与韧性。Across Taiwan, this series explores 13 revived, preserved, or overlooked agricultural and fishery treasures, following farmers and fishers through long days, wild weather, and hard-earned traditions rooted in the land.

programme.title: 香港探秘地图 / The Map Of Truth Episode 20
programme.desc: 玄学家庄一臣靠“撞鬼事件”爆红，更组建探秘团队追查连串灵异怪事。打假网红毕萍为揭穿他的真面目加入团队，却在一次次诡秘经历中发现他不为人知的一面。与此同时，富豪之子离奇失踪，一场真假玄学交锋悄然展开……Master Zhuang, a feng shui expert, gains fame through his channel exploring Hong Kong's mysterious sites, but his rise is challenged by a skeptical influencer determined to expose him. When a tycoon’s son mysteriously vanishes, an eerie mystery begins to unfold…

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 97
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 984
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 339
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 245
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 56
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 婚内婚外 / Married Episode 17
programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在“无微不至”的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相。在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的“美满”婚姻中挣脱出来。而在找回自我、尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助。然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的“战斗”就此打响。

programme.title: 飞常日志 II / The Airport Diary II
programme.desc: 香港国际机场升级变身“机场城市”！四位机场骨干带领三名个性十足的新人, 天才少年、富家千金和昔日偶像，勇闯跨境旅游、机场营运及保安前线。面对接连不断的挑战，三人边学边闯、突破自我，展开一场精彩又热血的成长之旅！Hong Kong International Airport is becoming a new “Airport City.” Four experienced airport staffs welcome three very different newcomers—a young genius, a rich heiress, and a former idol. As they take on new jobs and challenges, learn, grow, and discover what they are truly capable of.

programme.title: 但愿人长久 / Teresa Teng Episode 28
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了“华语世界永恒的声音”邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的“超级女声”的奋斗之路 。Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asia’s most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 341
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 99
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 飞常日志 II / The Airport Diary II Episode 2
programme.desc: 香港国际机场升级变身“机场城市”！四位机场骨干带领三名个性十足的新人, 天才少年、富家千金和昔日偶像，勇闯跨境旅游、机场营运及保安前线。面对接连不断的挑战，三人边学边闯、突破自我，展开一场精彩又热血的成长之旅！Hong Kong International Airport is becoming a new “Airport City.” Four experienced airport staffs welcome three very different newcomers—a young genius, a rich heiress, and a former idol. As they take on new jobs and challenges, learn, grow, and discover what they are truly capable of.

programme.title: 但愿人长久 / Teresa Teng Episode 29
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了“华语世界永恒的声音”邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的“超级女声”的奋斗之路 。Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asia’s most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.desc: 香港国际机场升级变身“机场城市”！四位机场骨干带领三名个性十足的新人, 天才少年、富家千金和昔日偶像，勇闯跨境旅游、机场营运及保安前线。面对接连不断的挑战，三人边学边闯、突破自我，展开一场精彩又热血的成长之旅！Hong Kong International Airport is becoming a new “Airport City.” Four experienced airport staffs welcome three very different newcomers—a young genius, a rich heiress, and a former idol. As they take on new jobs and challenges, learn, grow, and discover what they are truly capable of.

programme.title: 但愿人长久 / Teresa Teng Episode 30
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了“华语世界永恒的声音”邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的“超级女声”的奋斗之路 。Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asia’s most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 58
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 100
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 342
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.desc: 落魄的高嘉岳突然回家了，离家多年后回来，嘉岳发现其实家中每个人都有各自的不同难题：爸妈感情失和、二弟在家中没有归属感、三弟对未来很茫然，但他们还是跌跌撞撞地在人生道路上前进着。眼看家人都这么尽力地活着，嘉岳认为是时候去完成轻生的打算了……。台湾Netflix的爆红剧，由金马影帝吴慷仁、影后杨贵媚及金钟男配角喜翔、女配角孙可芳领衔主演，不容错过！

programme.title: 白日提灯 / Love Beyond the Grave Episode 9

Since then, they agreed contractually to exchange their five senses, and continued to work together to maintain peace between the human and spiritual worlds.

programme.title: 八尺门的辩护人 / Port of Lies Episode 5
programme.desc: 某个平静的夜里，基隆八尺门地区发生灭门血案。一名印尼渔工将阿美族船长一家三口残杀至死。与死者出身同部落的公设辩护人佟宝驹，被迫站在族人对立面，受命为渔工辩护。佟宝驹带领法院替代役及通晓嫌犯语言的印尼籍看护组成辩护小组，层层深入案情，竟牵扯出官商勾结的共犯结构。这部以法律题材为主轴的迷你剧在2024年的金钟奖囊括了7个奖项，包括最佳迷你剧集、编剧、配乐及最佳男主角奖。On a quiet night, the captain of a fishing boat and his family are brutally murdered. All the evidence points to Abdul-Adl, an Indonesian fishing worker. Tong, a public defendant of the same Amis origin of the captain, is appointed to go against his community to defend the suspect. However, all is not as it seem...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 13
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 白日提灯 / Love Beyond the Grave Episode 6
programme.desc: 该剧讲述了天赋卓然的鬼王贺思慕，在休沐觅食时意外遇见了小将军段胥，两人互相试探，互通五感。贺思慕终于了解了段胥黑暗的过往以及心中的志向，段胥也发现了贺思慕的坚守和孤独，寿命不过百年的凡人和四百岁仍是少女的恶鬼，以爱意抵抗时间洪流，携手守护美好人间。The four-hundred-year-old strong female ghost master He Si Mu and the mysterious major general Duan Xu met because of the broken delusion sword. Since then, they agreed contractually to exchange their five senses, and continued to work together to maintain peace between the human and spiritual worlds.

programme.title: 爱情没有神话 / Lady Liberty Episode 4
programme.desc: 该剧改编自亦舒同名小说，讲述了以林展翘、何韩为代表的独身男女们，在事业与情感的交织浪潮中，彼此形成深厚羁绊，他们不断探寻自我，最终与爱人、朋友一道绽放绚烂人生的故事。Lady Liberty” is adapted from Yi Shu’s famous novel of the same name. The drama follows Lin Zhanqiao, a financially independent woman, who is not against marriage but is unwilling to settle for less. She meets He Dezhang, and their relationship evolves as they navigate growth and choices in love and career. The drama also explores the lives of Lin Zhanqiao's female friends, their life choices, and their journey...

programme.title: 白日提灯 / Love Beyond the Grave Episode 11
programme.desc: 该剧讲述了天赋卓然的鬼王贺思慕，在休沐觅食时意外遇见了小将军段胥，两人互相试探，互通五感。贺思慕终于了解了段胥黑暗的过往以及心中的志向，段胥也发现了贺思慕的坚守和孤独，寿命不过百年的凡人和四百岁仍是少女的恶鬼，以爱意抵抗时间洪流，携手守护美好人间。The four-hundred-year-old strong female ghost master He Si Mu and the mysterious major general Duan Xu met because of the broken delusion sword. Since then, they agreed contractually to exchange their five senses, and continued to work together to maintain peace between the human and spiritual worlds.

programme.title: 爱情没有神话 / Lady Liberty Episode 9
programme.desc: 该剧改编自亦舒同名小说，讲述了以林展翘、何韩为代表的独身男女们，在事业与情感的交织浪潮中，彼此形成深厚羁绊，他们不断探寻自我，最终与爱人、朋友一道绽放绚烂人生的故事。Lady Liberty” is adapted from Yi Shu’s famous novel of the same name. Since then, they agreed contractually to exchange their five senses, and continued to work together to maintain peace between the human and spiritual worlds.

programme.title: 嫁金钗 / Where The Mask Ends Episode 3
programme.desc: Lu Zhuo gives his unwanted bride three days to leave. Determined to survive, she wins over his family and saves his brother, forcing a truce. But a servant's deadly attempt to drug her leaves a terrifying secret behind.

programme.title: 嫁金钗 / Where The Mask Ends Episode 4
programme.desc: After secretly disposing of a servant's body, Wei Rao faces a new trap during her return to the Wei household. Separated from her maid and locked inside a library, she watches in horror as oil is poured in and flames threaten to engulf her.

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 14
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 爱情没有神话 / Lady Liberty Episode 11
programme.desc: 该剧改编自亦舒同名小说，讲述了以林展翘、何韩为代表的独身男女们，在事业与情感的交织浪潮中，彼此形成深厚羁绊，他们不断探寻自我，最终与爱人、朋友一道绽放绚烂人生的故事。Lady Liberty” is adapted from Yi Shu’s famous novel of the same name. The drama follows Lin Zhanqiao, a financially independent woman, who is not against marriage but is unwilling to settle for less. She meets He Dezhang, and their relationship evolves as they navigate growth and choices in love and career. The drama also explores the lives of Lin Zhanqiao's female friends, their life choices, and their journey...

programme.title: 绝命法官 / Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪。然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年。随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流、警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景。Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 绝命法官 / Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪。然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年。随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流、警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景。Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 绝命法官 / Justice Is Mine Episode 3
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪。然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年。随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流、警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景。Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 食尚玩家:我们这一家 / Super Taste:Family On The Road
programme.desc: 《我们这一家》以三世代同游同食为主轴，走访在地美食，透过不同价值观的碰撞与理解，用吃喝玩乐串起世代故事

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 474
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 骗中传奇 / Game of Deceit Episode 19
programme.desc: 第十九集 正知井见儿后,恐儿揭穿上床一事.儿为了坤的一万万两,要挟正交出神像. 正布下骗局令坤带走假神像,岂料儿与坤反布局,真神像除落入他们手中,更令众人对正误会重重.正入宫向庆谢罪,玉喝下"绝情酒",令正除下牙人身份,免庆将正杀头,而坤则向庆暗示正巳投靠己方. 坤向正说出玉巳喝下毒酒,解药则在他手上,正惟有照坤计划行事. 九被坤手下追杀,误进儿房间,二人提及井,九向儿道出爱之真义,儿听罢后反往坤房间走去. 晨光初现,正催促坤前往大殿.

programme.title: 玫瑰战争 & 今日知多D / War Of Thorns & What's On Today Episode 12
programme.desc: 影后关子盈(陈自瑶饰)「自杀」七年后，其挚友夏无双(杨茜尧饰)意外获得子盈的日记，惊悉她当年疑遭「好姊妹」黎绮云(林夏薇饰)、蓝凤仪(姚子羚饰)、梁菲雅(傅嘉莉饰)、林安安(邝洁楹饰)背叛与加害。为追查背后真相及复仇，无双以合拍电影《玫瑰》作诱饵，博取娱乐公司老板陈云生(陈豪饰)的信任，拉拢四女参演。无双连手子盈的秘密情人李德龙(马国明饰)，并藉复制子盈曾遭遇的连串「意外」，挑起四女互撕……随着子盈被资本势力胁迫致死的真相逐渐浮现，众人光鲜亮丽的伪装瞬间粉碎，暴露出最不堪的人性阴暗面。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 77
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 329
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 跟风旅行团 / Seoul follow me! Episode 9
programme.desc: 「跟风」，意谓跟随一种风尚或潮流。主持杜如风看过网上平台的「百万点击影片」，百分百跟着片中人的踪迹，逛游韩国首尔的购物点、玩乐点，吃尽片内的餐厅、小店美食推介，到底百万人看过的片段，是「呃Like」引人中伏，还是「值得一推」？如风化身「真人版键盘战士」，留下超真实评语。除此之外，「跟风」亦可以有另一个意思，就是跟随任性如风的私心推介，继而自行创造独特的旅程，让观众也可名正言顺地「跟『风』」！

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021) Episode 44
programme.desc:
金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。
故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 236
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 173
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 38
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 329
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港早晨 及 世界观 / Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 骗中传奇 / Game of Deceit Episode 20
programme.desc: 第二十集 太和殿内,四神像伫立,玉却搬出另一"顺"神像,并称此乃真货. 正出现,将玉百般侮辱,玉无奈将牙人身份退让. 正谓真的"顺"神像是真金不怕烘炉火,但真神像竟被烧毁,此时坤才知被正出卖. 假神像内之满文透露大清祸胎乃是坤,庆名正言顺将坤斩首. 原来当天儿献身给坤,是要取得玉解药,免正被威胁. 儿决定重新做人,而井亦发觉自己爱上了九. 时日渐过,玉诞下双胞胎,九亦受井诚意感动,答允下嫁. 庆为免秘密被宣扬,遂赐封正"天下第一牙",让他们永享福禄.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 77
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 311
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 跟风旅行团 & 今日知多D / Seoul follow me! & What's On Today Episode 7
programme.desc: 「跟风」，意谓跟随一种风尚或潮流。主持杜如风看过网上平台的「百万点击影片」，百分百跟着片中人的踪迹，逛游韩国首尔的购物点、玩乐点，吃尽片内的餐厅、小店美食推介，到底百万人看过的片段，是「呃Like」引人中伏，还是「值得一推」？如风化身「真人版键盘战士」，留下超真实评语。除此之外，「跟风」亦可以有另一个意思，就是跟随任性如风的私心推介，继而自行创造独特的旅程，让观众也可名正言顺地「跟『风』」！

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 / The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5) Episode 18
programme.desc: 铁汉李家鼎(鼎爷)武艺非凡毋庸置疑，原来厨艺亦相当「耍家」！鼎爷设立「阿爷厨房」，伙拍对美食素有要求的谭玉瑛，每集带大家搜购心水食材，并由鼎爷亲自下厨，炮制多道拿手小菜、汤水及甜品，为大家奉上怀旧粤菜好滋味！如何以「抵食价」煮出正宗古法盐焗鸡的味道？怎样掌控蒸鱼的火候和时间？秋冬时份，不少人爱吃「香喷喷」煲仔饭，更不会错过香脆的饭焦，但大家又可曾见过有两面饭焦的煲仔饭？且看鼎爷大显身手，一一教路！

programme.title: 玫瑰战争 / War Of Thorns Episode 13
programme.desc: 影后关子盈(陈自瑶饰)「自杀」七年后，其挚友夏无双(杨茜尧饰)意外获得子盈的日记，惊悉她当年疑遭「好姊妹」黎绮云(林夏薇饰)、蓝凤仪(姚子羚饰)、梁菲雅(傅嘉莉饰)、林安安(邝洁楹饰)背叛与加害。为追查背后真相及复仇，无双以合拍电影《玫瑰》作诱饵，博取娱乐公司老板陈云生(陈豪饰)的信任，拉拢四女参演。无双连手子盈的秘密情人李德龙(马国明饰)，并藉复制子盈曾遭遇的连串「意外」，挑起四女互撕……随着子盈被资本势力胁迫致死的真相逐渐浮现，众人光鲜亮丽的伪装瞬间粉碎，暴露出最不堪的人性阴暗面。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 474
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 237
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 蝉 & 今日知多D / The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today Episode 7
programme.desc: 第二十一集：最终的日子来临，丁宁赴约参加毕先生的正式欢迎会。这一次，所有大人物都将出席，马婷婷的调查小组与公安部已随时待命，势必将犯罪团伙一网打尽。赵屹杰带着杨阿五来到余颂凡家做最终道别，他告知余颂凡一个重大秘密。余颂凡闻言失控，与赵屹杰扭打在一起，赵屹杰推门逃跑，却在开门瞬间遇到了一位意想不到的人。毕先生等人落网，丁宁联系不上余颂凡心急如焚。余颂凡开车带着阿五慌乱中疾驰，迎接自己最终的命运。

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 196
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline Episode 317
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021) Episode 45
programme.desc:
金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。
故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。

programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 世界观 / Global View
programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 475
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 骗中传奇 / Game of Deceit Episode 20
programme.desc: 第二十集 太和殿内,四神像伫立,玉却搬出另一"顺"神像,并称此乃真货. 正出现,将玉百般侮辱,玉无奈将牙人身份退让. 正谓真的"顺"神像是真金不怕烘炉火,但真神像竟被烧毁,此时坤才知被正出卖. 假神像内之满文透露大清祸胎乃是坤,庆名正言顺将坤斩首. 原来当天儿献身给坤,是要取得玉解药,免正被威胁. 儿决定重新做人,而井亦发觉自己爱上了九. 时日渐过,玉诞下双胞胎,九亦受井诚意感动,答允下嫁. 庆为免秘密被宣扬,遂赐封正"天下第一牙",让他们永享福禄.

programme.title: 玫瑰战争 & 今日知多D / War Of Thorns & What's On Today Episode 13
programme.desc: 影后关子盈(陈自瑶饰)「自杀」七年后，其挚友夏无双(杨茜尧饰)意外获得子盈的日记，惊悉她当年疑遭「好姊妹」黎绮云(林夏薇饰)、蓝凤仪(姚子羚饰)、梁菲雅(傅嘉莉饰)、林安安(邝洁楹饰)背叛与加害。为追查背后真相及复仇，无双以合拍电影《玫瑰》作诱饵，博取娱乐公司老板陈云生(陈豪饰)的信任，拉拢四女参演。无双连手子盈的秘密情人李德龙(马国明饰)，并藉复制子盈曾遭遇的连串「意外」，挑起四女互撕……随着子盈被资本势力胁迫致死的真相逐渐浮现，众人光鲜亮丽的伪装瞬间粉碎，暴露出最不堪的人性阴暗面。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 78
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 330
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021) Episode 45
programme.desc:
金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。
故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 237
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 174
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.desc:
第3集 青春剧 青葱岁月难忘记，这集拥抱青春，重拾愉快少年时。
潘静文、林君莲歌声引进「四叶草」时光，黎诺懿、唐诗咏难忘当年远赴塞班岛拍摄乐事。露云娜、詹天文合唱<荳芽梦>，可会勾起少女心事？
丁子朗、刘颖旋畅谈《青春不要脸》奋斗追梦写照；由施匡翘、黄剑文演绎剧中歌曲。校园剧引领共鸣，JW、炎明熹等演员回味《青春本我》带来的成长意义。
王梓轩偕林智乐、林沚羿，在户外呈献初恋之声；另送上何雁诗、郑俊弘<傻痴痴>MV。

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 37
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 312
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 破毒强人 / Narcotics Heroes Episode 29
programme.desc: 第30集 文华吐血昏倒后醒来，发现章琳整晚在身边守候，有感人生最后时光也不算太黑暗。手下见文华大势已去，想偷走毒品，被文华狠狠勒死。章琳将股票套现，约安乐一起劝文华收手，安乐暗中通知浩天；神秘人也致电浩天给予逮捕文华情报。章琳和安乐先到达制毒工场，惟费尽唇舌也劝不动文华；安乐仍关心文华，忍不住公开自己的卧底身分，着文华和章琳赶快逃跑。警方已抵达门外，文华只让浩天一人进来，却点起火苗触发粉尘爆炸……

programme.desc:
语「㜺鬼」传神，博大精深，香港不少俗话亦源自广东省各地。
㜺鬼大使麦美恩遂将探索版图扩展至中国，并找来邓智坚、戴祖仪、许文轩加入「㜺鬼导赏团」，深入广州等内地城市，发掘相关的有趣典故及出处。专业粤语及典故专家亦会现身，追源溯古引经据典，揭示贴地粤语的魅力所在。
此外，喜欢扮鬼扮马的邓智坚还于节目化身单身宅男，透过他追求一众「女神」的过程，让大家了解多个俗语及术语的含意。

programme.desc: AI功能越来越强大，如果画面中的关键细节被AI悄然抹走，大家是可凭记忆找回缺失的部分，还是集体陷入「脑雾」状态？陈展鹏率领甄敏芳、林智乐，一起主持问答游戏节目《弊家伙！有嘢唔见咗！》，每集邀请两队星级艺人斗智较量，争夺奖金。节目中，AI化身「记忆擦胶」，篡改大众熟悉的神剧、经典音乐、地标场景等，队员要凭记忆寻回被抹走的真相。经过四个回合的脑力激战，累积分数较高的队伍将可挑战赢取Jackpot大奖！

programme.title: 女神配对计划2 / A Date with Goddess (Sr.2) Episode 12
programme.desc: 恋爱真人骚《女神配对计划》火热回归，第二季恋爱战场全面升级！「金牌媒人」Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，为女神何沛珈、郭佩文、陈若思、俞可程、阮嘉敏开展恋爱配对。求爱勇者接受心动揿灯、五角枱约会等挑战，各出奇谋冧女神。一对一亲密游戏引爆心跳警报，还有隐藏女神加入战团，火花进一步升温……更多求爱考验来临，勇者们力求走到最后，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神与星级嘉宾们轮流成为「花生团」，直击女神约会实况。

programme.title: J Music / J Music 2026 Episode 40
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高质音乐平台，一众歌手有展示音乐实力的机会之余，也可让乐迷更深入了解歌手的音乐故事。节目邀请「人气」歌手担任嘉宾，由嘉宾亲自挑选其喜欢的新旧作品，并即场演唱，分享喜爱曲目。而一些乐坛新面孔亦会亮相，透过互动交流，展现音乐潜力。此外，每集紧贴「劲歌金榜」最新形势，送上歌曲MV外，还会带来不同歌手、创作人或制作人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至音乐业界的人和事。

programme.title: 减肥男女 / Love On A Diet
programme.desc: Mini因初恋情人黑川的离开，由九头身美人变成一个大肥婆。潦倒时，她认识了斗气怨家卖刀佬肥佬。 肥佬知道Mini的经历后，设法助她重夺爱人心。Mini减肥成功，黑川为之惊艳。当她踌躇谁是最爱时，肥佬己消失在茫茫人海…

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 313
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 三个女人一个「因」 / Threesome
programme.desc: 生于司法界世家的方以因(黄智雯)，拜律政界红人欧阳一波(李国麟)为师，成绩出众，但学满师后却倒戈相向转做执业大律师，经常与师傅在庭上针锋相对。以因一直隐瞒自己有多重人格问题，次人格是狂野玩家菠萝椰奶(黄智雯)，好勇斗狠、另一个则是愁擘擘(黄智雯)，为人怕事悲观，愁眉苦脸，而得知此秘密的利东佳(袁伟豪)趁势要挟以因聘他为实习生，以因为保自己能顺利下嫁城中钻石王老五纪骁勇(陈智燊)，无奈答应，两人遂展开一段别开生面的经历，因为人格会突然转换，经常令以因在庭上丑态百出，闹出不少笑料；而惟一知道以因病源只有母亲方华绮思(黄淑仪)，可惜，绮思对往事绝口不提，期间东佳更与椰奶和擘擘渐成好友，以因为除后患，决心令她们一同消失……

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2026 Episode 44
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 流行经典50年 / Cantopop At 50 Episode 141
